content.text: LEFT/RIGHT move   Enter restart   B back

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.gridW = 20
v.gridH = 13
v.paddleX = 8
v.paddleY = 12
v.paddleW = 4
v.ballX = 10.0
v.ballY = 10.0
v.ballVX = 8.0
v.ballVY = -8.0
v.score = 0
v.inputX = 0
v.boardText = ""
v.gameOver = false
v.gameWon = false

-- initialize bricks
v.bricks = {}
for y = 1, 4 do
    for x = 2, v.gridW - 3 do
        table.insert(v.bricks, {x=x, y=y, active=true})
    end
end
scripts.update:
local v = ctx.v
local dt = time.dt

if v.gameOver or v.gameWon then
    return
end

-- player movement
if v.inputX ~= 0 then
    v.paddleX = v.paddleX + v.inputX * 15.0 * dt
    v.inputX = 0
end
v.paddleX = math.max(0, math.min(v.gridW - v.paddleW, v.paddleX))

-- ball movement
v.ballX = v.ballX + v.ballVX * dt
v.ballY = v.ballY + v.ballVY * dt

-- left/right bounce
if v.ballX <= 0 then
    v.ballX = 0
    v.ballVX = -v.ballVX
elseif v.ballX >= v.gridW - 1 then
    v.ballX = v.gridW - 1
    v.ballVX = -v.ballVX
end

-- top bounce
if v.ballY <= 0 then
    v.ballY = 0
    v.ballVY = -v.ballVY
end

-- bottom loss
if v.ballY >= v.gridH then
    v.gameOver = true
end

-- paddle collision
if v.ballY >= v.paddleY - 0.5 and v.ballY <= v.paddleY + 0.5 and v.ballVY > 0 then
    if v.ballX >= v.paddleX - 0.5 and v.ballX <= v.paddleX + v.paddleW - 0.5 then
        v.ballY = v.paddleY - 0.5
        v.ballVY = -v.ballVY
        -- add some english based on hit position
        local hitPos = (v.ballX - (v.paddleX + v.paddleW/2)) / (v.paddleW/2)
        v.ballVX = v.ballVX + hitPos * 5.0
    end
end

-- brick collision
local bx = math.floor(v.ballX + 0.5)
local by = math.floor(v.ballY + 0.5)
local activeBricks = 0

for i, b in ipairs(v.bricks) do
    if b.active then
        activeBricks = activeBricks + 1
        if bx == b.x and by == b.y then
            b.active = false
            v.score = v.score + 10
            v.ballVY = -v.ballVY
            break -- only hit one brick per frame
        end
    end
end

if activeBricks == 0 then
    v.gameWon = true
end

-- render to text
local text = ""
local pX = math.floor(v.paddleX)

for y = 0, v.gridH - 1 do
    for x = 0, v.gridW - 1 do
        local char = "."
        
        -- paddle
        if y == v.paddleY and x >= pX and x < pX + v.paddleW then
            char = "="
        -- ball
        elseif x == math.floor(v.ballX) and y == math.floor(v.ballY) then
            char = "O"
        -- bricks
        else
            for i, b in ipairs(v.bricks) do
                if b.active and b.x == x and b.y == y then
                    char = "#"
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        text = text .. char
    end
    text = text .. "\n"
end

if v.gameOver then
    text = text .. "GAME OVER\n"
elseif v.gameWon then
    text = text .. "YOU WIN!\n"
end

v.boardText = text
